question: The Indian National Congress formally took up the Swadeshi call in its Benaras session of 1905 under the presidentship of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gopal Krishna Gokhale**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian National Congress formally adopted the Swadeshi call in its Benaras session of 1905.
 
• This session was presided over by **Gopal Krishna Gokhale**.
 
• The Swadeshi movement was part of the Indian freedom struggle, advocating for the boycott of British goods and the revival of domestic products and production processes.
 
• It aimed to promote self-reliance and reduce dependence on British imports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gopal Krishna Gokhale** was a prominent leader of the Indian National Congress and a social reformer.
 
• He was known for his moderate views and advocacy for constitutional methods of protest against British rule.
 
• The Swadeshi movement gained momentum after the partition of Bengal in 1905, which was seen as an attempt to divide and rule by the British.
 
• The movement played a crucial role in the economic and cultural awakening of India.
 
• It laid the foundation for future movements and the eventual independence of India in 1947.
